0.en: 2. Dialectic of the Categories of Essence26)

en: Essence 1. is the whole-in-itself of the manifold determinate being, taken away from the changeability and perishability of the finite.
This perishable manifold taken together constitutes the inessential.
Essence, however, as the whole of the determinacies of determinate being, must 2. itself be determinate being, and thus have the side of inessentiality, which is consequently itself essential.
This essential inessentiality is appearance. - Essence in its essential inessentiality, or in its appearance, distinguishes itself into matter and form.27)
zh: 本质 1. 是从有限者的可变化和易逝中取出来的、杂多定在自在的整体。
这种易逝的杂多合起来构成非本质者。
但本质作为定在诸规定的整体，本身 2. 就必须是定在，因而也就有非本质性的这一面，而这一面本身也就因此是本质的。
这种本质性的非本质就是现象。——本质在它本质性的非本质中，或在它的现象中，区别为物质和形式。27)

en: We are finite beings - reason an infinite individual - indivi[dual] reason is finite on the contrary.
zh: 我们是有限的存在者——理性、无限个体——[个别]理性毋宁是有限的。

en: The essence that remains in appearance as such is matter.
It is the persisting, insofar as it is for itself without determinacy and inequality, which belong to form.
Matter for itself is thus formless and passive; form comes to it externally.
Matter, however, is in itself simply the many-outside-one-another, which is just as much in a continuity equal to itself.

Form, then, is nothing other than the unity that distinguishes itself in itself; it is thus the same as matter; and its truth is the unity of matter and form; the matter that forms and is formed, or the form which has its matter in itself.
zh: 作为这样的现象而持存的本质就是物质。
它是那持存的，就其自为而言：它没有规定和不等同，而规定和不等同是属于形式的。
所以物质自为时是无形式而是被动的；形式从外面加到它身上。
但物质自在地全然是彼此在外分开的多数，它同样处在一种与自身等同的连续性中。
那么形式无非是在自身中区别着自身的统一；所以它与物质是同一个东西；而它的真理是物质与形式的统一；是既赋形又已被赋形的物质，或者说，是在自身中带有自己物质的形式。

en: The most superficial form of matter is to be a whole which consists of parts.
The parts are the indeterminate manifold as such, which relates itself to a unity; this unity, which is not for itself but essentially the relation of this manifold, is composite.
zh: 物质最表面的形式就是成为一个由部分组成的整体。
部分一般就是不定的杂多，它关联于一个统一；这个统一不是自为的，而是本质上就是这杂多的关系，它是复合的。

en: The following antinomy is contained in this relation:
zh: 在这一关系中包含着如下的二律背反：

en: Matter consists of simple parts, and only the simple is what truly exists, since composition is a merely external relation; the composite as such therefore cannot be in itself, but only the simple is in itself.
zh: 物质由单纯的部分组成，而且只有单纯者才是真正存在的东西，因为复合只是一种纯粹外在的关系；所以复合者作为复合者不能在自在中，只有单纯者才在自在中。

en: In the earlier antinomy, going beyond from the absolute limit to the limit as such.
Here in 1., from the limit as such to the absolute limit, - the simple part.
zh: 在前一个二律背反中，是从绝对界限走向界限本身。
这里在 1. 中，是从界限本身走向绝对界限，——单纯的部分。

en: Matter does not consist of simple parts, and the simple parts or atoms have no existence; for the atom is essentially in continuity with one another through their indistinguishability and equality; but this continuity is the mere possibility of simple parts and has sublated their existence; matter is thus divisible to infinity.
zh: 物质不由单纯的部分组成，单纯的部分即原子并没有存在；因为原子凭着彼此的不可区分性和等同性，本质上处在相互的连续性中；但这种连续性只是单纯部分的可能性，它扬弃了它们的存在；所以物质可以无限地分。

en: Zeno's example: the body moving more slowly, which has a space in advance, keeps an advance, because while the second reaches the point where the first is, the first has come on further, - the infinite divisibility of time.
Continuity of time, the possibility of catching up.
zh: 芝诺的例子：走得较慢的物体，前面有一个空间的距离，它保持着这个领先，因为在第二个到达第一个所在的那个点时，第一个又向前走了——时间的无限可分性。
时间的连续性，追上的可能性。

en: The antinomy of the relation of the whole and the parts reduces in general to the following:
zh: 整体与部分这一关系的二律背反正一般归结为下面这一条：

en: The whole consists of the parts, and the parts make up the whole.
But
zh: 整体由部分组成，而部分又组成整体。
但是

en: 2. the whole does not consist of the parts as parts, for the whole is not in the part as part.
The parts thus make up the whole only in their coming-together.
But the coming-together of the parts is the whole.

Thus only the two tautologies result: the parts as parts are only parts; only the whole is the whole; or part and whole are indifferent to one another, and the relation falls apart; that is, it is no relation at all.
zh: 2. 整体并不是由作为部分的部分构成的，因为整体不在作为部分的部分之中。
所以部分只有在它们的集合中才组成整体。
但部分的集合就是整体。
这样只得到两个同义反复：部分作为部分只是部分；只有整体才是整体；或者部分与整体彼此不相干，于是这一关系就散开了；也就是说，它根本不是关系。

en: The determinate form in its activity directed outward is force.
Force is 1. grounded in itself and active from itself.
It has a determinate content; but form is essentially unity with the content.
It is 2. thus likewise determined as activity.
But the determinacy of activity as such is being-conditioned.
Force is therefore grounded in itself just as much as it has a condition.
It is therefore just as little an absolute relation as the relation of the whole and the parts.
zh: 规定形式在其向外的活动中就是力。
力是 1. 以自身为根据，并由自身而活动。
它有一个规定的内容；但形式本质上是与内容的统一。
它 2. 因此同样作为活动而是规定的。
但活动本身所具有的这种规定性就是受条件性。
因此力既以自身为根据，同时又有一个条件。
因此它同整体与部分的关系一样，也不是一个绝对的关系。

en: The condition of force is itself a force, as a soliciting activity.
This, the conditioning side, is itself conditioned as force, namely by the first; or it is soliciting only in that it is solicited by the first to be it.
Since this being-conditioned is therefore mutual, only this whole is the unconditioned.
zh: 力的条件本身就是力，一种召唤的活动。
这个作为条件的东西本身作为力也是受条件的，而且是通过第一个力；或者它只是因此才是召唤的，即它是被第一个力召唤着去成为它。
既然这种受条件性是相互的，那么只有这个整体才是无条件者。

en: Into the unconditioned relation the opposition of possibility and actuality enters.
The actual is not distinguished from its possibility by a determinate content, but solely by determinate being, as empty form.29) 1.
What is actual is possible.
Possibility, however, does not contain actuality within itself, and even what is not actual is possible.
If something is truly possible, that is, if all its conditions are present, then it is necessary; but the necessary is actual.
Bare possibility without actuality is therefore essentially distinguished from true possibility, which is necessity, by the deficiency of the content.
zh: 在无条件的关系中，可能与现实性的对立随之出现。
现实者与自己的可能性并不是通过某个规定的内容相区别，而只是通过定在，即作为空的形式相区别。29) 1.
凡是现实的东西都是可能的。
但可能性并不把现实性包含在自身之内，而且非现实的东西也是可能的。
如果某物是真正可能的，也就是它的一切条件都具备，那么它就是必然的；而必然的东西是现实的。
因此，没有现实性的单纯可能性与那种就是必然性的真正可能性，其根本区别在于内容的缺陷。

en: Possibility includes within itself all the conditions themselves, namely that in the conditioned relation the conditions present themselves opposed to the existent; something can be possible without ...
Possibility merely wants to indicate the incomplete simplicity of the content of the conditions.
Possibility and actuality are therefore not merely a difference of the form of determinate being, but of the content.

The entry into determinate being appears as a contingency (a spark that falls upon powder) — ripeness for revolution. — in the understanding of God the possible is immediately also actual; in the finite understanding it is otherwise, i.e. imagined possibility.
True possibility is also actual.
Comprehending [means] developing something out of its conditions, out of its possibility; to see through all the conditions.
zh: 可能性本身就把一切条件包含在内，即在有条件的关系中，条件与存在者相对而出现；某物可以是可能的而无需……
可能性只想标示出诸条件内容的不完全单纯性。
所以可能性与现实性并不单单是定在的形式上的差别，而是内容上的差别。
进入定在显现为一种偶然性（一颗落到火药上的火星）——革命的成熟。——在上帝的知性中，可能的东西直接地就是现实的东西；在有限的知性中则不同，即想象出来的可能性。
真正的可能性同时也是现实的。
以概念把握［就是］从某物的条件、从它的可能性［把它展开出来］；看清一切条件。

en: Substance is the being that persists in all determinacy and change of determinate being; the determinations of determinate being constitute the accidental, and change belongs to this alone.

Each individual thing is a particular substance, for it is the being that in general, in pure indeterminate equality with itself, constitutes its simple matter; but into this equality with itself no change falls, rather it is the substratum of all change of determinate being.
The self-equal being of the individual thing is essentially a determinate being, for otherwise it would not be the being of this thing; but as it is, it is subject to change.

Since substantial being is to be indeterminate in order to persist, all difference of the particular things is sublated; the particular things as such are therefore no substances, and there is only one substance.
zh: 实体是在定在的一切规定与变化中持存着的存在；定在的那些规定构成偶性，而变化只属于这个偶性。
每一个个别的东西都是特殊的实体，因为它是就存在而言一般地、在与自身的纯粹无规定的同一性中构成其单纯的物质的那个东西；但这种与自身的同一性中并不落入任何变化，它反倒是定在的一切变化的基底。
单个东西这种与自身同一的存在本质上是某种有规定的存在，因为否则它就不是这个东西的存在；但正因如此，它是受变化支配的。
由于实体性的存在为了持存应当是无规定的，特殊诸物的一切差别就被扬弃了；特殊诸物作为特殊物因此便不再是实体，因而只有一个实体。

en: Substance — the individual thing burns away, the accidental of its existence [ad 1] α) Individuality, β) Individuality is determinacy [ad 2] All determination, space, indifferent determinate being
zh: 实体——个别之物焚毁，其存在的偶性 [ad 1] α) 个别性，β) 个别性即规定性 [ad 2] 一切规定、空间、与之无关的定在

en: In the one substance all particularity and individuality in general are only something accidental and are sublated in it.
It is the lower-lying relation which has not yet risen to the concept of subjectivity.
To begin with, substance is negative unity in that all particularity is sublated in it; because it is immediately only what persists, what is positive, and determination, negation, should not be its.
As substantial negative unity it contains the higher determination, that of being cause.
zh: 在这一实体中，一切特殊性与个别性一般说来都只是偶性，并且在它里面被扬弃。
它是较低一层的关系，还没有上升到主观性的概念。
起初，实体由于一切特殊性在它里面被扬弃而是否定性统一；因为它直接地只是那持存着的、正的东西，而规定、否定本不该落到它头上。
它作为实体性的否定性统一，包含着更高的规定，即成为原因的规定。

en: at the level of substance [all particularity] disappears — substance not yet as cause, as power.
zh: 在实体上[一切特殊性]消失了——实体尚不是原因、尚不是力量。

en: In the causal relation the following antinomy arises:
zh: 在因果关系中产生出如下的二律背反：

en: Causality according to laws of nature is not the only causality from which the appearances of the world can be derived.
For their explanation it is still necessary to assume a causality through freedom.
zh: 依照自然规律的因果性并不是唯一能据以推出世界现象的那种因果性。
为解释这些现象，还必须假定一种通过自由的因果性。

en: Proof: Let us assume that there is no causality other than according to laws of nature; thus everything that happens presupposes a previous state, on which it follows inevitably according to a rule.
But now the previous state itself must be something that has happened, because if it had always existed, then its consequence would not first have arisen either, but would always have existed.

Since therefore the causality of the cause is itself something that has happened, an infinite progress of the series of cause and effect results, i.e. only an incomplete series, and thus only a cause that insufficiently determines and grounds.
zh: 证明：假定不存在依照自然规律以外的任何因果性；这样，一切所发生的事都预设一个先前的状态，并按照一条规则必然地继之而来。
可是，先前的状态本身必定是已经发生过的东西，因为如果它一直就已存在，那么它的结果也不是后来才产生出来，而是一直就已经存在了。
因此，由于原因本身的因果性也是已经发生过的东西，就得出原因与结果之序列的无限进展，也就是说，这只是一个不完全的序列，因而只是一个尚不足以规定并起根据作用的原因。

en: A causality must therefore be assumed which is absolute spontaneity, that is, a free cause which of itself begins a series of appearances that runs according to laws of nature.
zh: 因此必须假定有一种因果性，它是绝对的自发性，即一种自由的原因，它自行开始一串按自然规律运行的现象。

en: There is no causality through freedom, but everything in the world happens merely according to laws of nature.
zh: 没有通过自由的因果性，而是世界上的一切都仅仅按照自然的规律发生。

en: Proof: Suppose there is a causality according to freedom, namely a capacity to begin absolutely a state and hence also a series of its consequences; then the determination of spontaneity will also begin absolutely, so that nothing precedes by which the action of freedom would be determined.

But every beginning to act presupposes a state of the cause that is not yet acting; and an absolutely first beginning of the action [presupposes] a state which has no connection whatever of causality with the preceding state of the same cause, that is, in no way follows upon it.
Thus absolute freedom is contrary to the law of causality.
zh: 证明：假定有一种依照自由的因果性，即一种能够全然开始一个状态、从而也开始这个状态的一串结果的能力；那么自发性的规定也将全然开始，以至于没有任何东西先行，而自由的行为将由它得到规定。
但是每一次开始行动都以尚未行动的原因的一个状态为前提；而行动的一个全然最初的开始[预设]一个状态，它与同一原因先前那个状态在因果性上毫无联系，也就是说，绝不是由后者而来。
所以绝对自由与因果规律相抵触。

en: The purer form of the dialectic of the causal relation is this: 1.

Cause is distinct from effect, and indeed distinct in form; the former is the original and the active; the effect, however, is not this through itself, but another posited thing; the cause is as such free in general, insofar as the movement starts from it.

2. But the cause is not distinct from the effect in content; there is nothing in the effect which is not in the cause; and conversely nothing in the cause which is not in the effect, for the cause is only a cause insofar as an effect becomes through it. 30) Further, its passing over into the opposed or its acting is thereby necessary 31), for it has meaning only insofar as it has an effect; it goes out entirely in the effect or passes over into this, and on account of this necessity the cause is not free.
It is, even though the beginning of the activity itself a moment of the whole of necessity or a contingent thing; and the absolutely first is only this whole.
zh: 因果关系的辩证法的更纯粹的形式是这样的：1.
原因是与效果相区别的，而且是就形式而言相区别；前者是原初者和能动者；而效果不是通过自身，而是另一个被设定者；原因作为这样的原因一般来说就是自由的，就运动从它发出而言。
2. 但原因就内容而言并不与效果相区别；效果中没有什么是不在原因中的；反过来原因中也没有什么是效果中所没有的，因为原因唯有在有效果通过它产生出来时才成其为原因。30) 此外，它过渡到对立面或者说它的起作用由此也就成为必然的31)，因为它唯有在有一个效果时才有意义；它总之在效果中熄灭或过渡到效果中去，而正因这一必然性，原因就不是自由的。
它是，尽管活动的这一开始本身是必然性整体的一个环节或是一件偶然的事；而绝对的第一者只是这个整体。

en: [ad 1] Cause is not absolute because it is also effect, but because it is cause [ad 2] 2. equal; bad equality - cause is also effect
zh: [ad 1] 原因并非因为同时是效果才绝对，而是因为是原因 [ad 2] 2. 才相同；坏的相同——原因也就是效果

en: Thereby a reciprocal action of one and the same with itself is posited, which is just as much its cause as its effect, or which has the whole form within itself and lets it run on within itself, or posits itself in the opposed determinations and remains the same in them.
zh: 由此设定了同一个东西与自身的一种相互作用，它同样既是自己的原因也是自己的效果，或者说，它在自身中具有整个形式并让这个形式在自身中流转，或者它把自己设定在相互对立的诸规定之中，并在其中保持同一。

en: The concept is the universal which is at the same time determined but which in its determinacy remains the same whole universal.
zh: 概念是这样一个普遍者：它同时已被规定，但在其规定中仍然是同一个完整的普遍者。

en: Man is man, colour is colour, lion is animal, Caius (Cajus) is man.
I am universal in my individuality - infinite - not determined through its limit I am the whole
zh: 人是人，颜色是颜色，狮子是动物，卡尤斯（Cajus）是人。
我在我的个别性中是普遍的 - 无限的 - 并不通过它的界限而得到规定 我就是整体

en: The moments of the concept are individuality, particularity and universality.
The concept contains them as simple abstractions which are contained in one unity.
zh: 概念的诸环节是个别性、特殊性和普遍性。
概念把它们作为简单的抽象包含在内，这些抽象包含在一个统一之中。

en: Difference of a concept from a representation. cf. common marks; this being
zh: 概念与表象的差别。见共同的标志；这些存在

en: The universal is this unity as a positive undetermined unity equal to itself. 32) Particularity is the determinacy of the universal, but in such a way that it is sublated [is] in the universal or that the universal remains in it what it is.
Individuality is the negative unity or the determinacy which sums itself up into [absolute] self-determination.
zh: 普遍者是这样的统一，即作为肯定的东西、与自身相等的不确定的统一。32) 特殊性是普遍者的规定，但方式是这样的：它在普遍者中被扬弃[是]，或者说普遍者在它之中仍然是它所是的东西。
个别性是否定的统一，或者说那种在[绝对]的自我规定中把自身归结起来的规定。

en: The universal comprehends the particular and the individual, and the particular [comprehends] the individual under itself, whereas the individual comprehends particularity and universality in itself, and the particular comprehends universality in itself.

The universal is wider than the particular and the individual, whereas particularity and individuality comprehends more in itself than the universal, insofar as the latter is itself again a determinacy.
The universal inheres in the particular, whereas it subsumes the particular under itself.
zh: 普遍者包含特殊者和个别者，特殊者[把]个别者包含在其下，反之个别者把特殊性和普遍性包含在自身之中，而特殊者把普遍性包含在自身之中。
普遍者比特殊者和个别者更宽，反之特殊性和个别性在自身中比普遍者包含得更多，就此后者本身又是一个规定性而言。
普遍者固有于特殊者，反之它把特殊者归摄在其下。

en: Subordinated and coordinated. 33)
zh: 从属与并列。33)

en: The judgment is the presentation of an object in the differentiated moments of the concept.
It contains
zh: 判断是一个对象在概念的各个相异环节中的展现。
它包含

en: 1. the same [object] in the determinacy of individuality, as subject,
zh: 1. 同一个[对象]在个别性的规定中，作为主体，

en: 2. in the determinacy of universality, or its predicate, - or again the subject may stand to the predicate as individuality to particularity or as particularity to universality;
zh: 2. 在普遍性的规定中，即它的谓词，——或者主体对谓词也可以像个别性对特殊性、或像特殊性对普遍性那样；

en: 3. the simple contentless relation of the predicate to the subject: is, the copula.
zh: 3. 谓词对主体的单纯无内容的关系：就是，即连系词。

en: Predicate - Not as an accidental one, because the individual itself as such is universal.

Cajus is away on a journey; being away on a journey is more universal than this man; being away on a journey befalls several; having been away is something that has happened, a contingency: the universal must be a universal of the subjects, that by which the subject is universal.
zh: 谓词——不是作为偶性的谓词，因为个别者本身作为这样的个别者就是普遍的。
卡尤斯出门旅行去了；旅行出门比这个人更普遍；旅行出门落到好几个人身上；旅行出门是一件发生过的事，一种偶然性：普遍者必须是主体的普遍者，即主体借以成为普遍者的那个东西。

en: From the judgment one must distinguish the proposition in which something quite individual, something that has happened, is predicated of a subject 34); or also, as in the universal propositions, something with which it is connected according to necessity 35), into which it passes and toward which it relates itself essentially as something opposed.

Because in the concept the moments are comprehended as being in one unity, in it [sc. in the judgment] 36) there is indeed determinacy, but not as becoming or oppositional setting; (the relation expressed by the copula is simple and immediate, a connection of universality and equality), and the lower determinacy immediately raises itself to the more universal which is different from it, or rather is already raised to it.
zh: 应当把命题与判断区分开来，在这种命题中，关于一个主体说出了某种完全个别的、发生过的事34)；或者，如在普遍命题中那样，是某种按照必然性与它相联的东西35)，它过渡到这种东西，并本质上作为与之相对立者而与之相关。
因为在概念中诸环节是被包含在一个统一之中的，所以在它[即判断]36)中固然有规定，但不是作为生成或对立；（由连系词所表达的关系是单纯而直接的，是普遍性与等同的联系），而且较低的规定直接上升到那与它不同的、更普遍的东西，或者毋宁说已经提升到它了。

en: In logic the judgment is considered with respect to its form, without regard to any determinate empirical content.
zh: 在逻辑学中，判断就其形式来考察，不顾及任何特定的经验内容。

en: whether I, my representation of something, agrees with the object, is not the question at all - it makes no difference to me, to be sure - but whether reality in and for itself expresses the nature of the concept.
zh: 我关于某物的表象是否与对象相符，根本不在话下——这对我倒无关紧要——而在于实在性本身是否表达了概念的本性。

en: The judgments differ by the relation which subject and predicate have toward each other in their regard for one another, insofar as their relation is one through and in the concept or a relation of objectivity to the concept.
zh: 各种判断按主体与谓词在相互的参照中所具有的那种关系相区别，就此它们的关系是经由概念并在概念之中的关系，或是一种对象性对概念的关系。

en: The higher or absolute truth of the judgment depends on this relation; truth is the agreement of the concept with its objectivity, and in the judgment this presentation of the concept in its objectivity, and so the domain of truth, begins.
zh: 判断的更高的或绝对的真理取决于这一关系；真理是概念与它的对象性的一致，而在判断中，概念在其对象性中的这种展现，因而真理的领域，便开始了。

75.en: 1. Quality of the judgments or judgments of inherence

en: Immediately, in the judgment the predicate is a property which belongs to the subject in such a way that although as the universal in general it relates itself to the subject, at the same time it inheres in it alone and is a determinate Dasein of it, of which it has several determinacies.

The universality of the predicate thus has here the meaning of an unm[ittelbaren] sensible universality and of mere communion with others (and the subject, as well as this its determination, is an object, an object in general); - a judgment of Dasein and taken from Dasein in general.
zh: 直接地，在判断中谓词是一个属性，它这样属于主体：虽然作为一般的普遍者它与主体相关，但同时又只固有于主体，并且是主体的一个特定的定在，它有好几个规定性。
所以谓词的普遍性在这里具有 unm[ittelbaren] 感性普遍性以及与他人的单纯共同性的意义（而主体，如同它的这一规定一样，是一个对象、一个一般而言的对象）；——一个定在的判断，并且是从一般而言的定在中取来的判断。

en: The immediate judgment, insofar as its pure form is expressed as its mere content, would be: the individual is universal.
Affirmative judgment as such.
zh: 直接判断，就其纯粹形式被表述为它的单纯内容而言，会是：个别者是一般者。
肯定判断本身。

en: as yet no necessary relation in the concept
zh: 概念中还谈不上必然的关系

en: But just as much, because of the difference between particularity and universality, the judgment would have to be expressed thus: the individual is not universal.
Negative judgment as such.
zh: 但同样地，由于个别性与普遍性的相异，判断就必须表述为：个别者不是一般者。
否定判断本身。

en: This judgment cannot be reversed, on account of the essential difference between subject and object.
The individual is universal: α) the predicate as such is universal over against the subject, β) the subject is itself universal; no accident can be its predicate.
zh: 由于主体与客体的本质性相异，这一判断不能倒过来。
个别者是一般者：α) 谓词本身相对于主体来说是一般者，β) 主体本身就是一般者，偶然物不能成为它的谓词。

en: In this judgment the separation of the predicate from the subject is indeed posited, but since this separation is at the same time a relation, there is as yet in the first instance an affirmative judgment present; the negation is to be taken as a determination of the previously empty universality of the predicate; and the expression of the judgment is: the individual is a particular.
zh: 在这个判断中，谓词与主体的分离固然被设定了，但既然这一分离同时又是一种关系，那么起初首先仍然存在的便是一个肯定判断；否定应当被看作对谓词先前那空着的普遍性的规定；而这一判断的表达是：个别者是一个特殊者。

en: The concept indeed has the three moments of individuality, particularity and universality.
But the judgment is immediate: individuality is universality.
For the judgment expresses the separation. - Through the judgment "the individual is the particular" the judgment acquires a content, for particularity is the unity of individuality and universality.
But content is the equality of subject and object.
(Substantial unity.)
zh: 概念固然具有个别性、特殊性和普遍性这三个环节。
但判断是直接的：个别性就是普遍性。
因为判断表述的正是这一分离。——通过判断“个别者是特殊者”，判断获得了一个内容，因为特殊性是个别性与普遍性的统一。
而内容就是主体与客体的等同。
（实体性的统一。）

en: Insofar as the predicate is now expressed as the particular, it is a universal which is at the same time a determinate one.
It is an affirmative judgment with a content.
zh: 既然谓词现在被表述为特殊者，它就是一个同时又是规定者的一般者。
这是一个带内容的肯定判断。

en: The individual is a particular - α) the particular is individuality, thus this particular.
Negative judgment: individuality is not this particular but another (only the determinacy is negated). β) The particular is universality, thus the particular as such.
Negative judgment: individuality is not the particular as such (universality is negated, the sphere) - infinite judgment.
zh: 个别者是一个特殊者——α) 特殊者就是个别性，即这一个特殊者。
否定判断：个别性不是这一个特殊者，而是另一个（只是规定性被否定）。β) 特殊者就是普遍性，即特殊者本身。
否定判断：个别性不是特殊者本身（普遍性被否定，即这一领域）——无限判断。

en: Here subject and predicate have the determinacy in common, but are different with respect to individuality and universality.
Because of this difference, the judgment must be expressed thus: the individual is not a particular.
zh: 在这里，主体与谓词共具有规定性，但就个别性与普遍性而言却是相异的。
由于这一相异，判断必须表述为：个别者不是一个特殊者。

en: This negative judgment has a double meaning, because the predicate, the particularity, contains the determinacy as well as the moment of universality; thus what is negated is sometimes only the determinacy, and sometimes the universality is negated along with it.

Insofar as only the determinacy of the predicate is negated without the universality, the universal sphere which the predicate contains remains, and a positive relation to this sphere is still present; the judgment is the negative judgment of the content.
zh: 这一否定判断有双重的含义，因为谓词即特殊性既包含规定性，也包含普遍性的环节；这样，被否定的有时只是规定性，有时则是普遍性跟规定性一起被否定。
如果只否定谓词的规定性而不否定普遍性，那么谓词所包含的那个普遍领域就仍然保留下来，并且对它还存在着一种肯定的关系；这个判断就是内容上的否定判断。

en: But insofar as the particularity also contains universality in itself, the universal sphere is negated along with the determinacy, and thus no positive relation of the subject to the predicate at all remains; the judgment is sublated; - 3. infinite judgment.
zh: 但如果特殊性本身也包含普遍性，那么普遍领域就跟规定性一起被否定掉，于是主体对谓词就再也一点都不剩任何肯定的关系了；判断被扬弃了；- 3. 无限判断。

en: "The body is not absolutely heavy" could indeed be regarded as an infinite judgment, because no sphere remains; but heaviness is not a quality of which the body would have several.
A whale is no door The spirit no acid
zh: “物体不是绝对沉重的”倒可以看作无限判断，因为没有哪个领域留下来；但沉重并不是物体可以有几个的那种质。
鲸鱼不是门 精神不是酸

en: Insofar as the sublation of the judgment is regarded as a sublation of it according to its form, in that the determination of subject and predicate has fallen away as against each other, the sublated or infinite judgment also has a positive expression, namely that of the identical judgment: the individual is an individual which has no difference of subject and predicate, and thus is properly no judgment.
zh: 如果把判断的扬弃看作就其形式而言的扬弃，即主体与谓词的相互规定已经彼此消失，那么这个被扬弃的、也就是无限判断也有一种肯定的表达，即同一判断的表达：个别就是个别，它没有主体与谓词的差别，因而实际上并不是一个判断。

99.en: 2. Quantitative Judgments or Judgments of Reflection

en: The judgments of quality contain a comparison of several subjects with respect to a predicate.
The quantitative judgment is 1. a singular judgment, whose subject is this thing and is supposed to have for its predicate a quality which belongs only to this subject.
zh: 质的判断包含着若干主体就某个谓词所作的比较。
量的判断是：1. 单称判断，它的主体是这个事物，并应当就谓词具有一种只属于这个主体的质。

en: The identical judgments can be reversed; the qualitatively positive judgments cannot.
zh: 同一的判断可以颠倒过来；质上的肯定判断则不行。

en: The qualitatively negative judgments can be reversed insofar as in them the predicate is negated of the subject, and thus merely according to form the same would be taken as non-predicate, as subject; but on account of the content37) it would indeed remain a negative judgment, in which, however, subject and predicate have only the appearance of this relation to each other.
zh: 质上的否定判断之所以可以颠倒过来，是因为在它们那里谓词被从主体上否定掉了，因此单就形式而言，同一个东西就会被当作非谓词、当作主体；不过由于内容37)，它仍然会是一个否定判断，但在这个判断中主体与谓词彼此只是具有这一关系的假象。

en: The quantity of the judgments expresses itself in the subject.
The reflecting power of judgment determines the subject, namely through such predicates as are common to it along with several others, and insofar as they are so.
The subject is thereby determined insofar as the predicate belongs to a multitude of the same subjects.
zh: 判断的量表达在主体上。
反思的判断力正是通过这样的谓词来规定主体：这些谓词为它与另一些主体所共有，并且也正是在与另一些主体共有的这一限度上。
主体由此得到规定，也就是在这个限度上：这个谓词属于同一批主体的众多者。

en: Equality of subject and predicate.
zh: 主体与谓词的等同。

en: The individual judgment has an individual - this singular - as its subject, and says of it not so much a determinacy as a constitution.
zh: 个别判断以一个个别者——这个个别物——作为它的主体，并且对它说出的与其说是一种规定性，不如说是一种性质。

en: The particular judgment has as its subject: some individuals, of whom it says the same constitution.
zh: 特称判断以一些个别者作为它的主体，并且对他们说出同一种性质。

en: The universal judgment has as its subject: all individuals; in which thus the subject is extended to universality, which otherwise would accrue only to the predicate as such.
zh: 普遍判断以所有个别者作为它的主体；主体由此被扩展到普遍性，而这种普遍性原本只会落到谓词本身身上。

en: Fate is unjust; is a reflection, a general mode of conduct.
zh: 命运是不公的；这是一种反思，一种普遍的行动方式。

en: This spectacle is brilliant; reflect on the fact that it costs a great deal, that it has a moral influence; i.e. that it also takes on other determinations.
zh: 这场演出很辉煌；要反思的是：它花费很大，具有道德上的影响；也就是说，它还带上别的规定。

en: Judgment - inherence.
1. positive.
zh: 判断——固有。
1. 肯定的。

en: α) Relation of subject and predicate - opposition - predicate of universality (predicate: the universal)
zh: α) 主体与谓词的关系——对立——普遍性的谓词（谓词：普遍者）

en: β) Predicate determinacy - subject more general - common content of subject and predicate
zh: β) 谓词的规定性——主体更普遍——主体与谓词的共同内容

en: γ) Equality - quantitatively the same - common compass of subject and predicate.
zh: γ) 等同——量上相同——主体与谓词共同的范围。

123.en: 4. Doctrine of Consciousness for the Middle Class38)
123.zh: 4. 面向中产阶级的意识学说38)

en: Our ordinary knowing represents to itself only the object which it knows, but not at the same time itself, namely knowing itself.
The whole, however, which is present in knowing, is not only the object but also the I that knows, and the relation of my own self and the object to one another: consciousness.
zh: 我们通常的知识只向自己表象它所知的对象，却不是同时也表象自身，即知识本身。
但在知识中所存在的整体，不仅是对象，而且还有知道着的「我」，以及我与对象彼此之间的这种关系：这就是意识。

en: In philosophy the determinations of knowing are not considered one-sidedly merely as determinations of the things, but at the same time along with the knowing to which they at least belong in common with the things; or they are taken not merely as objective but also as subjective determinations, or rather as determinate ways in which the object and the subject are related to one another.
zh: 在哲学中，知识的诸规定不是片面地仅仅被看作事物的诸规定，而是同时连同那种知识一起被考察——这些规定至少是同事物一起共同属于那种知识的；或者说，它们不只是作为客观的规定、而且也作为主观的规定被取得，或者更确切地说，是作为对象与主体彼此相互关系的若干确定方式被取得。

en: Since things and their determinations are in knowing, on the one hand the representation is possible that the same things are in and for themselves outside consciousness and are simply given to it as something foreign and ready-made; on the other hand, however, since consciousness is just as essential to knowing, the representation is also possible that consciousness itself posits this its world and produces or modifies the determinations of that world through its conduct and its activity wholly or in part itself.
The former mode of representation has been called realism, the other idealism.
Here the general determinations of the things are to be considered in general only as a determinate relation of the object to the subject.
zh: 由于在知识中有着事物及其诸规定，一方面可以表象到：这些事物自在自为地在意识之外，并且作为外来的、现成的东西被直接给予意识；但另一方面，由于意识对于知识同样是本质的，也就同样可以表象到：意识自己设定它这个世界，并且通过自己的举止与活动，全部或部分地自己产生或改变这个世界的诸规定。
前一种表象方式被叫做实在论，后一种被叫做观念论。
在这里，事物的这些普遍规定大体上只应被看作对象对主体的一种确定关系。

en: The subject, thought more determinately, is spirit.
It appears as essentially relating itself to an existing object: insofar it is consciousness.
The doctrine of consciousness is therefore the Phenomenology of Spirit.
zh: 主体若想得更确定一些，就是精神。
它是显现着的，因为它本质上与一个存在的对象相关联：就此而言，它就是意识。
因此，意识的学说就是《精神现象学》。

en: Spirit, however, according to its self-activity within itself and in relation to itself, independently of the relation to the Other, is considered in the proper doctrine of spirit or psychology.
zh: 但精神就其自身之内的自我活动以及与自身的关系来说，独立于与他物的关系，则是在真正的精神学说或心理学中被考察的。

en: Consciousness in general is the knowing of an object, whether it be an external or an internal one, without regard to whether it presents itself to consciousness without any doing of Spirit or whether it has been brought forth through Spirit.
Spirit is considered according to its activities, insofar as the determinations of its consciousness are attributed to it itself.
zh: 意识一般是对一个对象的知识，无论这个对象是外在的还是内在的，也不管它是不经精神的作用而向意识呈现自己，还是由精神产生出来的。
精神是就其活动来考察的，即就意识的诸规定被归于它自己而言。

en: Consciousness is the determinate relation of the I to an object.
Insofar as one starts from the object, it can be said that it is different according to the diversity of the objects which it has.
zh: 意识是「我」对对象的特定关系。
如果从对象出发，那么可以说，意识随它所具有的各个对象的不同而不同。

en: At the same time, however, the object is essentially determined in its relation to consciousness.
Its diversity must therefore conversely be regarded as dependent on the further development of consciousness.
This mutuality already takes place in the sphere in which consciousness itself appears, and leaves the question raised above (§ 3) undecided: what these determinations are in and for themselves.
zh: 但同时，对象在与意识的关系中本质上是得到规定的。
因此反过来看，对象的不同要取决于意识的进一步形成。
这种相互性就发生在意识自身所显现的领域里，并且使上面（§ 3）提到的问题悬而未决：这些规定自在自为究竟算个什么。

en: In general, consciousness has three stages according to the diversity of the object as such.
It is, namely, either the object standing over against the I, or it is the I itself, or something objective which belongs just as much to the I, the thought.
These determinations have not been taken up empirically from outside, but are moments of consciousness itself.
It is therefore:
zh: 意识一般按照对象本身的不同有三个阶段。
也就是说，它要么是与「我」相对立的对象，要么就是「我」自己，要么是同样属于「我」的某种对象性的东西，即思想。
这些规定不是从外面经验地接受来的，而是意识自身的诸环节。
所以是：

en: consciousness in general,
zh: 意识一般，

en: self-consciousness,
zh: 自我意识，

en: reason.
zh: 理性。

147.zh: 第一阶段 意识一般

en: Consciousness in general is 1. sensuous, 2. perceiving, 3. comprehending.
zh: 意识一般 1. 是感性的，2. 是知觉的，3. 是知性的。

en: The simple sensuous consciousness is the immediate certainty of an external object.

The expression for the immediacy of such an object is that it is, and that precisely this one, now according to time and here according to space, entirely different from all other objects and fully determined in itself.
zh: 简单的感性意识就是对外在对象的直接确定性。
这样一个对象的直接性的表述在于：它存在，而且正是这一个——此时按时间、此地按空间——完全与一切别的对象不同，并且在它自身上充分得到规定。

en: Both this now and this here are a vanishing.
The now is no longer in so far as it is, and another now has taken its place, which has just as immediately vanished.
Yet the now remains at the same time.

This remaining now is the universal, which is both this now and that now, and at the same time none of them. — This here, which I mean and point out, has a right and a left, an above and a below, a behind and a front stretching to infinity, that is, the here pointed out is not a simple, and so determinate, here, but an aggregate of much.
What is therefore present in truth is not the abstract sensuous determinacy, but the universal.
zh: 这个这时和这个这里都是一个消失着的东西。
这时在它存在的时候就已经不是了，另一个这时取代了它的位置，但那个这时也同样立即消失了。
但与此同时，这时仍然留存着。
这个留存着的这时就是普遍者，它既是这个这时也是那个这时，同时又不是它们中的任何一个。——这个我所意指并且指示出来的这里，有一个右与左、一个上与下、一个后与前，一直伸向无限；也就是说，被指出来的这里不是单一的、因而是得到规定的这里，而是众多者的总合。
所以真正实有的并不是抽象的感性规定性，而是普遍者。

en: Perception no longer has as its object the sensuous, insofar as it is immediate, but insofar as it is at the same time universal.
It is a mixture of sensuous and reflective determinations.
zh: 知觉不再以直接的那种感性为对象，而是以同时又是普遍的那种感性为对象。
它是感性规定与反思规定的混合。

en: The object of this consciousness is therefore the thing with its properties.

The sensuous properties are α) for themselves both immediately in feeling and at the same time determined through the relation to others and mediated; β) they belong to a thing and in this regard are on the one hand contained in the individuality of that thing, on the other hand they have universality, according to which they transcend this individual thing and at the same time are independent of one another.
zh: 因此这一意识的对象就是物连同它的属性。
感性属性 α) 就其自身而言既直接地在感觉之中，同时又由同他者的关系得到规定，因而是中介的；β) 它们属于某一个物，就这一点而言，它们一方面被包含在这个物的个别性之中，另一方面又具有普遍性，按照这种普遍性它们越出这个个别物，同时又彼此独立。

en: Insofar as the properties are essentially mediated, they have their existence in an Other and they change.
They are only accidents.

The things, however, since they consist in their properties, distinguishing themselves thereby, dissolve along with the alteration of these properties and are a changeover of coming-to-be and perishing.
zh: 既然属性在本质上是中介的，它们的存在就在于他者之中，并且它们会改变。
它们只是偶性。
但是这些物既然在于它们的属性之中，并借此彼此区别开来，它们便随着这些属性的改变而消解，并且是产生与消逝的更替。

en: In this alteration it is not only something that sublates itself and becomes an Other, but the Other also perishes.
But the other of the other, or the alteration of the alterable, is the becoming of that which persists, that which subsists in and for itself and is inner.
zh: 在这种改变中，不只是某物扬弃自身而成为他者，他者也随之消逝。
但他者的他者，或者说可改变者的改变，乃是那持存者、那个自在自为地存在者以及内在者的生成。

en: The object now has the determination α) to have a purely accidental side, but β) also to have an essentiality and something that persists.
Consciousness, since the object has this determination for it, is the understanding, for whom the things of perception count only as appearances and which contemplates the inner of things.
zh: 对象现在具有这样的规定：α) 有一个纯粹偶性的方面，但 β) 也有一种本质性和一个持存者。
意识由于对象对它具有这样的规定，便是知性；对它来说，知觉的物只算作现象，而它考察物的内在者。

en: The inner of things is what in them is on the one hand free of appearance, namely of its manifoldness, which constitutes an externality relative to itself, — on the other hand, however, that which is related to it through its concept.
It is therefore 1. the simple force which passes over into determinate being, into expression.
zh: 物的内在者，是物上的这样一点：一方面它摆脱了现象，即摆脱了现象的杂多，而这种杂多构成一种对自身而言外在的东西；——另一方面，它又是那通过自己的概念而与之相关的东西。
因此它是 1. 单纯的力量，它过渡到定在、到表现。

en: The force remains the same with this difference in all the sensuous diversity of appearance.
The law of appearance is its quiet, general image.
It is a relation of general, persisting determinations whose difference in the law is at first an external one.

The universality and constancy of this relation indeed leads to its necessity, but without the difference being a determinate or inner one in itself, in which one of the determinations immediately lies in the concept of the other.
zh: 力量带着这一区别，在现象的一切感性差异中依旧是同一个。
现象的规律是它平静的、普遍的形象。
它是普遍的、持存的规定之间的一种关系，这些规定在规律中的区别起初是外在的。
这一关系的普遍性和恒常性固然导向它的必然性，但区别并不是一个自在地得到规定的、内在的区别，其中并没有哪一规定直接就处在另一规定的概念之中。

en: This concept, applied to consciousness itself, gives consciousness another stage.
Up to now, in its relation to its object, it was something foreign and indifferent.
Now that the difference in general has become a difference which is just as much no difference, the previous manner in which consciousness differed from its object falls away.
It has an object and relates itself to an Other, which however is immediately just as much no Other, or it has itself for its object.
zh: 这个概念应用于意识自身，就给了意识以另一个阶段。
此前，就同自己对象的关系而言，它还是一个外来的、漠然的东西。
如今这个区别总的说来已成为一个同时又并非区别的区别，于是，意识与自己的对象相区别的那种先前方式就消失了。
它有一个对象，并且关联于一个他者，但这他者直接地同样并不是他者；或者说，它把自己当作自己的对象。

en: Or directly: the inner of things is the thought or concept of the same.
When consciousness has the inner for its object, it has the thought or, just as much, its own reflection or form, thus in general itself for its object.
zh: 或者直接说：事物的内在者就是它们的思想或概念。
意识把内在者当作自己的对象时，它就具有思想，或者同样具有它自己的反思或形式，因而总的说来就是把自己当作自己的对象。

en: As self-consciousness, the I looks at itself, and the expression of this in its purity is I = I or I am I.
zh: 作为自我意识，自我观照自身，而它在纯粹时的表达就是 Ich = Ich 或者 Ich bin Ich。

en: This proposition of self-consciousness is devoid of all content.
The drive of self-consciousness consists in this: to realize its concept and to give itself the consciousness of itself in everything.
It is therefore 1. active in sublating the otherness of the objects and equating them with itself, 2. externalizing itself and thereby giving itself objectivity and determinate being.
Both are one and the same activity.
The coming-to-be-determined of self-consciousness is at the same time a self-determining of itself, and conversely.
It produces itself as object.
zh: 自我意识的这个命题没有任何内容。
自我意识的冲动在于：实现自己的概念，并且在一切方面给自己以关于自身的意识。
因此它 1. 是能动的：扬弃对象的他在并把它们与自身等同起来，2. 使自己外化，并由此给予自己对象性和定在。
两者是同一个活动。
自我意识受到规定同时就是自我规定，反之亦然。
它把自身产生为一个对象。

en: Self-consciousness has in its formation or movement the three stages: 1. of desire, insofar as it is directed toward other things, 2. of the relation of lordship and bondage, insofar as it is directed toward another self-consciousness unequal to it, 3. of universal self-consciousness, which recognizes itself in other self-consciousnesses, and indeed as equal to them, just as they are equal to it.
zh: 自我意识在其形成或运动中具有三个阶段：1. 欲望的阶段，就它指向别的物而言；2. 主人与奴隶的关系的阶段，就它指向另一个与它不平等的自我意识而言；3. 普遍自我意识的阶段，它在别的自我意识中认识自身，而且是在与它们平等之中，正如它们也与它平等。

en: Both sides of self-consciousness, the positing and the sublating, are therefore immediately united with one another.
Self-consciousness posits itself through the negation of otherness and is practical consciousness.

If, then, in consciousness proper, which is also called the theoretical, the determinations of it and of the object changed in themselves, this now happens through the activity of consciousness itself and for its own sake.
It is conscious to itself that this sublating activity belongs to it.
In the concept of self-consciousness lies the determinacy of the difference not yet realized.
Insofar as this difference emerges in it at all, it has the feeling of an otherness within itself, of a negation of itself, or the feeling of a lack, a need.
zh: 自我意识的两个方面，即设定的和扬弃的，因而直接地合为一体。
自我意识通过对他在的否定而设定自身，它是实践的意识。
如果在那也称为理论的那个本来的意识中，意识自身与对象的诸规定曾自在地自行改变，那么现在这一改变是通过意识自身的活动并为了意识自身而发生的。
它自身意识到：这种扬弃的活动是归属于它的。
在自我概念中含着那个尚未实现的区别的规定。
只要这个区别总的说来在它身上显现出来，它就有一种在自身之内有他在的感觉，即对自身的否定，或者一种匮乏的感觉，一种需要。

en: This feeling of an otherness within itself contradicts its equality with itself.
The felt necessity to sublate this opposition is the drive.

The negation, or the otherness, presents itself to it as consciousness, as an external thing different from it, which however is determined through self-consciousness 1. as something conformable to the drive and 2. as something negative in itself, whose existence is to be sublated by the self and put into equality with it.
zh: 这种在自身之内有他在的感觉，与它同自身的相等相矛盾。
那种感觉到的、要扬弃这一对立的必然性，就是冲动。
否定，也就是他在，向它呈现为意识，呈现为一个外在的、与它不同的东西，而这个东西却由自我意识规定为：1. 与冲动相符合的，2. 自在的否定者，其存在须由自我加以扬弃，并置入与自我的相等之中。

en: The activity of desire therefore sublates the otherness of the object, its existence altogether, and unites it with the subject, and through this the desire is satisfied.

This satisfaction is therefore conditioned 1. by an external object existing indifferently towards it, or through consciousness; 2. its activity brings forth the satisfaction only through the sublation of the object.
Self-consciousness therefore attains only to its self-feeling.
zh: 因此欲望的活动扬弃了对象的他在，即对象的存在，并把它与主体结合起来，欲望由此得到满足。
这种满足因而以此为条件：1. 通过一个外在地存在着、对它漠不关心的对象，或者通过意识；2. 它的活动只有通过扬弃对象才产生出这种满足。
自我意识因此只达到了自我感觉。

en: In desire self-consciousness relates itself to itself as a singular.
It relates itself to an object without self, which in and for itself is another than the self-consciousness.
It therefore reaches this equality with itself in respect of the object only through the sublation of it.

Desire is therefore 1. destructive; 2. in its satisfaction there comes to be only the self-feeling of the being-for-itself of the subject as singular, the indeterminate concept of the subject joined with objectivity.
zh: 在欲望中，自我意识作为个别者关联于自身。
它关联于一个无自身的对象，这对象在自在自为上[是]不同于自我意识的另一个。
因此，就对象而言，它只有通过扬弃对象才达到这种与自身的相等。
欲望因而总的说来 1. 是毁灭性的；2. 在欲望的满足中，因而只达到了作为个别者的主体的自为存在的自我感觉，即与对象性相结合的主体的那个未定的概念。

en: The concept of self-consciousness as a subject which is at the same time objective gives the relation that for self-consciousness there is another self-consciousness.
zh: 自我意识作为一个同时又是客观的主体的这个概念，给出了这样一个关系：对自我意识来说，有另一个自我意识。

en: A self-consciousness which is for another is not for it merely an object, but its other self.
The I is not an abstract universality in which as such there is no difference or determination.
Thus, insofar as the I is an object to the I, in this respect it is the same for it as that which it is.
It beholds itself in the Other.
zh: 一个为另一个而存在的自我意识，对这另一个来说并不单单是对象，而是它的另一个自我。
「我」不是一种抽象的普遍性，在其中作为这样的普遍性既没有区别也没有规定。
既然「我」是对「我」的对象，那么在这一方面，它对它而言就是它所是的那个同一个。
它在另一个者中观照自身。

en: This self-intuition of the one in the other is 1. the abstract moment of sameness.
Each however also has the determination to appear for the other as an external object and insofar as such an immediate, sensuous, and determinate being.

Each is absolutely for itself and singular against the other, and it also demands of the other, as it is to be and to hold as such for the other, that its own freedom as one existing in and for itself in the other be beheld in the other, or that it be acknowledged by the other.
zh: 这一个在另一个者中的自我直观就是 1. 同一性的抽象环节。
但每一个也都另有一种规定，即对另一个者而言显现为一个外在的对象，并且就此而言显现为直接的、感性的、具体的定在。
每一个绝对地为自身，并且在另一个者面前是个别者；它也要求另一个者，作为这样的另一个者而存在并对它算数，去观照它自己的自由，即一个在另一个者中自在自为地存在者的自由，或者去承认它。

en: In order to make itself count as free and to be recognized, self-consciousness must present itself to another as free from natural determinate being.
This moment is as necessary as the moment of the freedom of self-consciousness in itself.

The absolute equality of the I with itself is essentially not an immediate one, but one which comes about through the sublation of sensuous immediacy and thereby also presents itself to another as free and independent of the sensuous.
Thus it shows itself in accordance with its concept and must, because it gives the I reality, be recognized.
zh: 为了使自己被看作自由并得到承认，自我意识就必须向另一个人表现出自己是脱离自然定在的。
这一环节和自我意识在自身中的自由这一环节同样必要。
自我与自身的绝对等同本质上不是一种直接的等同，而是这样的一种：它通过扬弃感性的直接性而成为这种等同，并由此也对另一个人表现为是自由的、独立于感性的。
它就这样地依照其概念显现出来，并且因为它给予自我以实在性，所以必须被承认。

en: But independence is freedom not so much outside and away from sensuous, immediate determinate being as rather within the same.
The one moment is as necessary as the other, but they are not of the same worth.

Insofar as the inequality enters, that for the one of two self-consciousnesses freedom over against sensuous determinate being, but for the other this determinate being over against freedom, counts as the essential, there enters between them, along with the mutual being-owed-recognition in determinate actuality, the relation of lordship and bondage, - or in general that of service and obedience, insofar as this difference of independence is present through the immediate relation of nature.
zh: 但独立自主并不在于感性直接定在之外、脱离它，而恰恰在于它之中。
一个环节和另一个环节同样必要，但两者的价值并不相同。
一旦那种不平等发生，即在两个自我意识之中，对这一个来说自由对于感性的定在是本质的，而对另一个来说这个定在对于自由却是本质的，那么随着在一定现实性中相互应当被承认的要求，主人与奴隶的关系就在它们之间产生了——或者总之是服役与服从的关系，只要通过自然的直接关系这种独立自主的差异已经存在的话。

en: Insofar as of two self-consciousnesses standing over against each other each must strive to prove and to assert itself as an absolute being-for-itself over against and for the other, that into which freedom is preferred to life enters into the relation of bondage and thereby shows that it is not capable, by itself, of abstracting from its sensuous determinate being for its independence.
zh: 既然两个相互对峙的自我意识中的每一个都必须力图证明并主张自己是一个绝对的、面对并为了另一个的自为存在，那么那个宁可就自由而言把生命置于优先的一方就进入了奴隶的关系，并由此表明：它没有能力单凭自己撇开自己的感性定在以取得自身的独立性。

en: This purely negative freedom, which consists in the abstraction from natural determinate being, does not however correspond to the concept of freedom, for this is the self-sameness in otherness, partly the intuition of its self in the other self, partly the freedom not from determinate being but in determinate being as such, a freedom which itself has determinate being.
The servant is without self and has another self to his self, so that in the master he is externalized and sublated as the individual I and intuits his essential self as another.
The master, on the contrary, intuits in the servant the other I as a sublated one and his individual will as preserved.
(The story of Robinson and Friday.)
zh: 然而这种在于从自然定在中作抽象的纯粹否定性的自由并不符合自由的概念，因为自由是在他在中的自身等同：一方面是对另一个自我中的自身的直观，另一方面不是脱离定在的自由，而是在定在之中的自由，一种自身具有定在的自由。
服役者是无自身的，对自己的自我来说另有一个自我，以致他在主人那里作为个别的自我被外化并被扬弃，同时把自己的本质自我直观为另一个自我。
相反，主人却在服役者身上直观到另一个自我已被扬弃，而他的个别意志则得到了保存。
（鲁滨逊（Robinson）与礼拜五（Friday）的故事。）

en: The servant's own and individual will, considered more closely, however dissolves in general into the fear of the master, the inner feeling of his negativity.

His labour for the service of another is partly an externalization of his will in itself, partly it is at the same time, along with the negation of his own desire, the positive shaping of external things through labour, in that through it the self makes its determinations into the form of things and intuits itself in its work as something objective.
The externalization of inessential arbitrariness constitutes the moment of true obedience.
(Peisistratus taught the Athenians to obey.
Thereby he introduced the Solonian laws into actuality, and after the Athenians had learned this, lordship was superfluous for them.)
zh: 但细究服役者自己的个别意志，总的说来它在对主人的恐惧中、在对自己否定性的内在感觉中消解了。
他为另一个人服役所做的劳动，部分是他自身意志的外化，部分则是：劳动连同对自身欲望的否定，正是通过劳动对外物的积极塑造，因为自我通过它把自己的规定变成物的形式，并在自己的作品里把自己直观为一个对象性的东西。
不本质的任意的外化构成了真正服从这一环节。
（庇西斯特拉图斯教雅典人服从。
由此他把梭伦的法律引入现实性，而雅典人学会这一点以后，当主人对他们来说就是多余的了。）

en: This externalization of individuality as self is the moment by which self-consciousness makes the transition to being general will, the transition to positive freedom.
zh: 个别性作为自我的这一外化就是那个环节，自我意识由此完成过渡，去成为普遍意志，即完成向积极自由的过渡。

210.zh: C. 自我意识的普遍性

en: Universal self-consciousness is the intuition of itself as a self that is not particular, not distinguished from others, but the universal self that is in itself.
Thus it recognizes itself and the other self-consciousnesses in itself and is recognized by them.
zh: 普遍的自我意识就是它把自身直观为这样一个自我的直观：这自我不是特殊的、不是与他人相区别的东西，而是自在地存在的、普遍的东西。
这样，它在自身中承认自己和其他自我意识，并由它们承认。

en: Self-consciousness is real to itself according to this its essential universality only insofar as it knows its reflection in others (I know that others know me as themselves) and, as pure spiritual universality, as one belonging to the family, the fatherland, etc., knows itself as the essential Self.
(This self-consciousness is the foundation of all virtues, of love, honour, friendship, courage, of every self-sacrifice, of all renown, etc.)
zh: 自我意识按照它这种本质的普遍性，只有在它知道自己在别人身上的反映（我知道，别人是把我当作他们自己那样知道）、并且作为纯粹精神的普遍性、作为家庭、祖国等等的成员，知道自己为本质的自我时，才对自己是实在的。
（这种自我意识是一切美德、爱、荣誉、友谊、勇敢、一切牺牲、一切声誉等等的基础。）

en: Reason is the highest union of consciousness and self-consciousness, or of knowing an object and knowing oneself.
It is the certainty that its determinations are just as much objective — determinations of the essence of things — as they are our own thoughts.
It is just as much the certainty of itself, subjectivity, as it is being or objectivity, in one and the same thinking.
zh: 理性是意识与自我意识、也就是对一个对象的知与对自身的知的最高结合。
它是这样的确定性：它的规定既同样是对象性的规定、是事物的本质的规定，也是我们自己的思想。
它同样既是对自身的确定性、主观性，也是存在或客观性，就在这同一个思维之中。

en: Or what we see into through reason is 1. a content which does not consist in our mere representations or thoughts that we make for ourselves, but which contains the being-in-and-for-itself essence of the objects and has objective reality, and 2. a content which for the I is no alien, nothing given, but is penetrated by it, appropriated by it, and thereby is likewise produced by it.
zh: 或者我们通过理性看出的东西，是 1. 一个内容，它不在我们替自己造出的单纯表象或思想之中，而是包含着对象自在自为的本质并具有客观的实在性；2. 这个内容对自我来说不是异己之物、不是被给定之物，而是被它贯穿、被它掌握，并因此同样是由它产生的。

en: The knowing of reason is therefore not the mere subjective certainty, but is also truth, because truth consists in the agreement, or rather in the unity, of certainty and being, or of objectivity.
zh: 所以理性的知不只是单纯主观的确定性，而且也是真理，因为真理在于确定性与存在、或者说与对象性的符合，或者更确切地说，在于二者的统一。

en: Oct.
A feeling is the manner in which we are affected by an object.40)
zh: 感觉是我们受一个对象感发的那种方式。40)

en: Categories are concepts in themselves, another is a B ...
feelings; sensuous representations; representation of understanding or category — concept in itself; concept as concept or concept of something
zh: 范畴自在地是概念，另一个是一个 B……
感觉；感性表象；知性表象或范畴——自在地是概念；概念作为概念或关于某物的概念

en: A representation in general is this determination: insofar as it is ascribed to the object, [it is] the determination which the object has, whether or not we have been affected by it.
zh: 表象一般说来就是这一规定：一旦它被归到对象身上，就是对象所具有的规定，不管我们是否受过它的感发。

en: A sensuous representation is the determination which an object has, insofar as we stand towards it only through the senses, or immediately.
zh: 感性表象是一个对象所具有的规定，只要我们对它只是通过感官、或者直接地、与之相对。

en: Representation of understanding.
zh: 知性表象。
